hypotheses.N0_ce_selection_adds_predictive_geometry: The CE-selected discovery basis reconstructs held-out CE residual routes at least 0.05 better than the earlier generic route basis in at least twelve layers.
hypotheses.N1_top_residual_routes_are_not_just_grad: Mean absolute residual-route/CE-gradient cosine is below 0.70 in every layer on both panels.
hypotheses.N2_both_helpful_and_harmful_poles_are_pr: Each panel has at least ten percent positive and ten percent negative residual CE effects in at least sixteen layers.
hypotheses.N3_novel_complement_recurrence_beats_hea: After removing the generic rank-four route subspace, mean rank-two discovery/replication complement cosine exceeds the 95th percentile of per-edge head-permutation nulls.
